name: Steam
summary: Steamworks as a module: friends, P2P, achievements, stats, leaderboards, cloud, lobbies, presence, overlay, tickets and DLC.
description: The complete STEAM_* command set, moved out of the interpreter into an INLINE module with identical names. The wrapper calls the Steamworks flat API and loads steam_api64.dll (Windows), libsteam_api.so (Linux) or libsteam_api.dylib (macOS) at runtime, so nothing is linked: download the Steamworks SDK from https://partner.steamgames.com/downloads/list and put sdk/redistributable_bin/win64/steam_api64.dll next to gbx.exe or the built EXE (or point GBX_STEAM_LIB at it). Without the library every command keeps its neutral value and STEAM_ERROR$() explains what is missing; the HTML5 player stays neutral.
author: GameBasiX
